seoOverview.heading: Integrate AI agents with Google Sheets
seoOverview.paragraph: Connect Google Sheets to an OrgSDK agent team and give workflows direct read and write access to your spreadsheets. Agents can read a range as a lookup or config source, append rows from workflow output, and update individual columns inside a structured table — running on a schedule or on demand, with an approval gate before any write. The plugin supports both A1 ranges and Google's structured table format, so existing sheets work without migration.
